name: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam House
namesake: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam (1931–2015) was an aerospace scientist who led India's satellite launch vehicle and missile programmes, and served as the 11th President of India.
about: Abdul Kalam House celebrates curiosity, hard work and service through science. Members are encouraged to dream big and to turn ideas into things that help people.

name: Mother Teresa House
namesake: Mother Teresa (1910–1997) founded the Missionaries of Charity in Kolkata and spent her life caring for the poorest and sickest. She received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979.
about: Mother Teresa House stands for compassion and service. Members lead community outreach and look out for one another on campus.

name: Rabindranath Tagore House
namesake: Rabindranath Tagore (1861–1941) was a poet, writer, composer and educator who wrote India's national anthem and won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.
about: Tagore House celebrates creativity, culture and learning without limits. Members lead the arts, literature and music on campus.
